prompt_transform.guidance: Audio prompts should define who is speaking, delivery tone, emotional restraint, articulation, and the line's narrative function.
prompt_transform.template: Action/Beat: voice delivery supports {action}; tone follows {emotion} and project style {style}.

negative_constraints: Do not ask for a generic beautiful voice without delivery intent.
Do not exaggerate emotion when the scene calls for restraint.
quality_checks: Speaker role and delivery tone are explicit.
The voice direction supports the story beat.

source_refs.label: ElevenLabs text to speech best practices
source_refs.note: Voice output benefits from explicit delivery, emotion, and pronunciation guidance.

prompt_transform.guidance: Audio timing should specify pauses, emphasis, pace, and rhythm so the voice cut can align with picture beats.
prompt_transform.template: Motion/Temporal Progression: pacing uses natural pauses and emphasis to make {action} readable.

negative_constraints: Do not overfill the line with continuous speech when the beat needs silence.
Do not use pauses so long that short-video pacing collapses.
quality_checks: Pause or pacing guidance is present.
Emphasis supports the important word or emotional turn.

source_refs.label: ElevenLabs pause guidance
source_refs.note: Speech timing can be controlled through explicit pause or break instructions.

prompt_transform.guidance: When a project has recurring narration or character voice, keep voice identity, pace, loudness, and emotional range consistent across clips.
prompt_transform.template: Continuity: maintain voice identity, pace, level, and emotional range for {subject} under {style}.

negative_constraints: Do not change narrator age, accent, or vocal texture between related nodes unless requested.
Do not let user preference override established voice identity.
quality_checks: Voice identity is reusable across clips.
Continuity language does not expose private voice references.

source_refs.label: ElevenLabs voice design documentation
source_refs.note: Voice prompts describe accent, character type, and voice qualities.

prompt_transform.guidance: Separate narration, sound effects, room tone, and music intent; keep effects secondary unless the node explicitly asks for sound design.
prompt_transform.template: Negative Constraints: keep speech, effects, room tone, and music separated; avoid effects overpowering narration.

negative_constraints: Do not bury narration under music or effects.
Do not add copyrighted music, brand cues, or unrequested crowd noise.
quality_checks: Sound effects support the scene without taking over.

source_refs.label: Adobe Premiere audio editing concepts
source_refs.note: Audio editing separates volume, pan, effects, and track-level control.
